description: Reviewed finite decision-path contract for the rebrand tool's public workflows.

approval.basis: This inventory is intentionally finite and practical; a maintainer may review or revise the denominator before treating it as an accepted contract.

exclusions: mirror has no ready public implementation in tools/rebrand; its fixture Git graph tests are not counted as mirror workflow coverage
line, branch, function, and whole-codebase path coverage are not represented by this inventory

workflows.reason: No ready public mirror workflow exists in tools/rebrand; do not infer coverage from sync fixture tests.

conditionSequence: sourceRef resolves to a committed Git tree
working-tree edits and untracked files differ from the pinned tree
a tracked path or blob contains a candidate term
paths.expectedObservable: Inventory uses the pinned commit and records lexical candidate evidence.
paths.expectedResult: The dirty or untracked file is absent and the committed README is a candidate.

conditionSequence: tracked entries include an excluded artifact root
included entries contain binary, executable, and symlink modes
classification and exclusion are evaluated before candidate reporting
paths.expectedObservable: Excluded roots are listed separately while special entries retain safe classifications.
paths.expectedResult: The dependency path is excluded; binary, executable, and safe symlink metadata is preserved.

conditionSequence: report destination is inside the source tree
report destination is outside the source tree and absent
the same report path is requested again
paths.expectedObservable: Unsafe placement and overwrite are rejected, while a new external report is written.
paths.expectedResult: The first external write succeeds and the second write fails without replacement.

conditionSequence: sourceRef resolves and output destination is absent
transform returns entries with an empty unresolved list
staged output passes publication
paths.expectedObservable: Generation publishes a provenance-marked snapshot from committed source bytes.
paths.expectedResult: The output verifies successfully and excludes dirty or untracked working-tree content.

conditionSequence: output destination already contains a published snapshot
generation is requested again for the same destination
paths.expectedObservable: Generation refuses to replace an existing destination.
paths.expectedResult: The original provenance marker remains present and unchanged.

conditionSequence: transform reports at least one unresolved item
publication has not started
paths.expectedObservable: Generation fails closed before publishing unresolved output.

conditionSequence: output contains a canonical provenance marker
all output entries match the marker digests and modes
paths.expectedObservable: Verification returns a valid snapshot result.
paths.expectedResult: The result is valid and reports the expected entry count.

conditionSequence: a previously verified output entry is changed
verification recomputes the entry digest
paths.expectedObservable: Verification rejects content that no longer matches provenance.
paths.expectedResult: The verification promise rejects with a provenance or digest error.

conditionSequence: verified snapshot source is an ancestor of the feature worktree
baseline paths are unchanged
dryRun remains true
paths.expectedObservable: Apply computes rename and change sets without mutating the worktree.
paths.expectedResult: The plan contains the expected rename and no provenance marker is written to the worktree.

conditionSequence: verified snapshot source is an ancestor of the feature worktree
baseline paths are unchanged
dryRun is false and destinations are safe
paths.expectedObservable: Apply writes the verified snapshot atomically on the named feature branch.
paths.expectedResult: The renamed and changed files contain snapshot bytes and the provenance marker exists.

conditionSequence: snapshot verification succeeds
the current worktree branch is not feat/*
paths.expectedObservable: Apply refuses to mutate a non-feature branch.
paths.expectedResult: The operation rejects and the baseline file remains unchanged.

conditionSequence: a valid literal rule set selects a present UTF-8 file
expected match count equals the discovered matches
the plan source digest still matches during application
paths.expectedObservable: Rules produce UTF-16 edit offsets and apply replacements without mutating the input object.
paths.expectedResult: Both literal occurrences are replaced and the original file map is unchanged.

conditionSequence: rename and preserve rules both match the same reference
the preserve rule accounts for the occurrence
paths.expectedObservable: Preservation suppresses the rename edit while retaining match accounting.
paths.expectedResult: The plan has zero edits and both rules report one match.

conditionSequence: a plan is created with source digests
the source file changes before applyEdits
paths.expectedObservable: Application rejects a plan whose source digest is stale.
paths.expectedResult: The stale plan throws and no transformed result is returned.

conditionSequence: a valid Rust entry is selected
rustfmt accepts the selected bytes
paths.expectedObservable: The selected Rust entry is formatted and receives formatter metadata.
paths.expectedResult: Formatted bytes differ from the compact input and the report names rustfmt.

conditionSequence: only one Rust path is selected
binary and symlink entries are not selected
paths.expectedObservable: Unselected entries retain their bytes and modes.
paths.expectedResult: The binary and symlink entries are byte-for-byte unchanged.

conditionSequence: the selected Rust path is absent from the entries
paths.expectedObservable: Formatting rejects an unknown selection before invoking rustfmt.
paths.expectedResult: The call throws an unknown-path validation error.
